comparison.objective: Fit, pin-align, seat, and hand-tighten an oxygen regulator onto a cylinder valve; candidate adjusts an already mounted damper and validates its dynamic response.
comparison.physical_skill: Occluded multi-pin/yoke alignment, insertion, washer seating, bimanual support, and repeated T-handle regrasping versus hex-key engagement, collar fine adjustment, counterholding, relocking, and test-cycle iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both pins at least 3 mm seated, axes within 3°, screw-tip centering, at least 0.75 N·m tightening, release, and no drop/tip violation. Candidate instead requires safe repeated stops and setting retention, but lacks numeric rebound, overload, lock-torque, and drift thresholds.
comparison.reason: This is the closest in bimanual stabilization and repeated tightening, but regulator mating and seal clamping test alignment/insertion, whereas the candidate tests parameter adjustment coupled to dynamic behavior.
